title: Capability and safety preflight
summary: Check live availability and derived-output safety before broad analysis.

workflow.purpose: Identify ready, partial, and unavailable intelligence domains.
Review active drift findings and quarantined derived algorithms.
Inspect individual feeds when a capability is partial or unavailable.

safety: Treat unavailable feeds as collection gaps, not evidence that an event did not occur.
Do not use quarantined derived outputs for decisions.
A quarantined evaluator does not invalidate an independent authoritative source feed.
